intro:
The UK is one of the world's leading destinations for international students, known for its well-established higher education system, respected universities and wide range of courses.

UK offers one-year master's degrees that reduce both tuition and living costs and a 18 months Graduate Route work visa after graduation.
why: One-year master's — faster return on investment
Graduate Route lets you work for 18 months after the degree
PhD and other doctoral graduates can receive 3 years stay back
Strong in business, law, media, design and engineering
No entrance exam required for most programmes
visa: Student Route visa. You apply with your CAS letter, financial proof held for 28 days, and TB test where applicable. Most decisions arrive within three weeks.
intakes: September is the primary intake; January is a strong secondary intake. Apply 8–10 months ahead — popular courses close early.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 55–65%+ in bachelor's; 2:1 equivalent for top universities

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS UKVI 6.5 overall (6.0 in each band typical)

req.label: Work experience
req.value: Preferred for MBA and executive programmes

req.label: Documents
req.value: Marksheets, Resume, SOP, 2 LORs, CV, transcripts, passport, 28-day bank statement

steps.title: Accept offer
steps.text: Pay the deposit and receive your CAS letter

steps.title: Hold funds 28 days
steps.text: Maintain tuition + living costs in the account for 28 consecutive days

steps.title: TB test
steps.text: Complete TB screening at an approved clinic

steps.title: Apply online
steps.text: Submit the Student Route application and pay IHS

steps.title: Biometrics
steps.text: Attend the visa centre; decisions typically in 3 weeks

work: Students can work 20 hours a week during terms. The Graduate Route then allows you to stay and work for 18 months without employer sponsorship — ideal for finding a Skilled Worker role.
workPoints: Skilled Worker route for long-term stay

faq.q: Is a one-year master's valid in India?
faq.a: Yes — UK master's degrees are widely recognised by employers and for further study.

faq.q: Do I need IELTS for the UK?
faq.a: Most universities require IELTS UKVI, though some accept MOI letters for Indian students.

faq.q: How much does the Graduate Route cost?
faq.a: There is an application fee plus IHS; it is applied for from within the UK after graduation.
